merchant/31417.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Berynel: Welcome to the exciting, bustling Town of Gludio! Even though this is a temple, the traffic is noisy here, isn't it?! I sell spellbooks. Not like an Elf, eh? Ha! Well... People change according to situations, don't they?

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
